creative_improvements.idea: Chase-entry filter — block entries within 0.15% of 5m extreme
creative_improvements.rationale: 62.5% of instant-death hard_max_loss trades entered within 0.2% of 5m extreme AFTER the move already happened. Trail family wins because they catch trends early. hard_max_loss family loses because they enter late during chop. A chase filter would block the late entries.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Block 5/8 instant-death trades identified. Conservative estimate: reduce hard_max_loss frequency by 15-20% without killing trail-family winners (trend entries often enter near extremes but CONTINUE).
creative_improvements.risk: medium — trend entries also enter near extremes. Needs backtest to verify winner impact <20%.

creative_improvements.idea: Volume confirmation filter for chase entries — if entry is near 5m extreme, require vol_ratio > 2.0x
creative_improvements.rationale: Refinement of chase filter. CHIP had vol_ratio 4.1x and still lost (single spike, not sustained). TURBO had vol_ratio 0.3x (no momentum). Volume alone doesn't separate, but vol_ratio < 1.0x + chase entry = instant death. Could block TURBO-type entries without blocking sustained trends.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Block low-volume chase entries (vol_ratio < 1.0x). Would have blocked TURBO (vol 0.3x) without blocking CHIP (vol 4.1x) — but CHIP still lost, so this is incomplete.
